The shop

Generated by TestReport in pkg/internal/mock/shop: the listings the shop renders, as filters over the catalog ranked by a profile. The shop ranks by what a shopper has done, never by who the shopper is: it does not see a persona, and its package does not import one.

ListingsRanked by what was learned

Listings

The category tree as a new shopper sees it: every listing filtered out of the catalog by Filter.Apply, never hand-picked, and ranked by a neutral profile, under which every product scores the same, so the order is the catalog's. The list id is the category's path; facets and sort travel as their own fields.

Ranked by what was learned

The women's fashion department ranked for four shoppers, each after one converting visit. The shop knows nothing but the vector the affinity corpus emits from each shopper's events; the avatar is for the reader. One visit is enough for the front of each listing to look like the shopper who made it.
